MODEL & PROVIDER
  model:           "test-model"
  provider type:   "gemini"
  base_url:        (default: generativelanguage.googleapis.com)
  request_timeout: default (120s)
  retry:           3 attempts (default), 1s initial backoff (default)
  prompt cache:    automatic on this wire (reported in the session log when the endpoint says so)
  max_output_tokens: 4096
  provider mapping (the wire fields this config will send):
    max_output_tokens: 4096 -> generationConfig.maxOutputTokens: 4096
    reasoning.budget_tokens: 8192 -> generationConfig.thinkingConfig.thinkingBudget: 8192
    temperature: 0.2 -> generationConfig.temperature: 0.2
    google recommends the default 1.0 on gemini 3 models; non-default may degrade output
    params keys (merged verbatim, values not shown): "labels"
    unknown request fields: rejected (400) - strict protobuf JSON
    tool schemas: sanitized for the gemini wire (an unsupported JSON Schema keyword or shape is a 400 there)
      "fs_write": stripped "additionalProperties", "properties.path.pattern"
      "tidy_tool": no keys stripped
      "shapey_tool": stripped "properties.deep (non-object schema replaced)", "properties.path.default", "properties.path.type (type array narrowed)"

TOOLS
  workspace: "/ws"
  fs builtins (fs_read, fs_write, fs_list): enabled
  shell: disabled
  subprocess tools: (none)

PERMISSIONS
  default policy: allow (unset)
  per-tool overrides: (none)
  note: without a TTY, every "ask" policy is auto-denied (headless fail-safe).

BUDGETS
  max_turns:  20
  max_tokens: 50000
  timeout:    none
  max_tool_result_bytes: built-in per-tool caps (fs_read 256 KiB, fs_list/subprocess/shell 64 KiB per stream, mcp 64 KiB)

CONCURRENCY
  lock: disabled (concurrent runs of this config are allowed)
  tool calls in a turn: parallel (default)

OUTPUT
  schema: none (final answer is unconstrained text)
